what: BINARY_MIGRATION_PLAN.md §7.1 / §0 references "src/cli/commands/init.ts" for --scan removal, but the actual aide-memory init command lives at src/cli/commands/memory/init.ts. The top-level src/cli/commands/init.ts is the legacy AIDE indexer init and never had --scan. Any future phase spawn reading the plan should apply it to src/cli/commands/memory/init.ts (and the CLI registration in src/cli/aide-memory.ts).
why: Phase 0 hit this; subsequent phases reading the same canonical plan (sharp-chebyshev-4a0dce) will hit it too. Pre-recording the correct path saves a re-investigation.
